messages.subject: RPresence
parts: Hi everyone, can I ask about RPresence in this group?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] RPresence
parts:
Dear Fernando,

In principle no, but just go ahead 🙂

Seriously: if you have questions relating specifically to program PRESENCE and its implementation in R, then you should ask on the user-group of that software (see www.phidot.org for coordinates). If it's more general about occupancy or related models, then this list may be OK.

Marc

Sent: Saturday, August 19, 2023 14:54
To: unmarked <unma...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: [unmarked] RPresence
Hi everyone, can I ask about RPresence in this group?

*** Three hierarchical modeling email lists ***
(1) unmarked (this list): for questions specific to the R package unmarked
(2) SCR: for design and Bayesian or non-bayesian analysis of spatial capture-recapture
(3) HMecology: for everything else, especially material covered in the books by Royle & Dorazio (2008), Kéry & Schaub (2012), Kéry & Royle (2016, 2021) and Schaub & Kéry (2022)
